A Salve for sundry sores called
the Leaden plaister
XXVII
Take one pt of oyle oliue of the best & of white
lead very well calcinated with dust 12 ounces of
Spanish sope incorporate all these well together in
an earthen pott well glased & when the oyntment is
prepared that the sope seemes to melt & is in=
corporated that the sope seemes abouesaid & put it upon
a small fire of coales continueing yor said fire an
houres & a halfe still stirring it on a bolt of boxe
fastned to a stick of wood, yr make yr fire some
what bigger, till the reddnes be turned into a grey
colour but yr must not leaue stirrings till the
matter be turned into the coulour of oyle seeme
darker, then drop it on a wooden trencher & if it
neither cleaue to yr fingers nor the trencher [fasten?]
enough, then thinke bloodes in that, the charcoale or
thereon dipped will last 20 yeares, pr of glase yr hase
this plaister laid to the stomach creates appetite and
takes away the paines of the Stomach laid to the
sides, tis a remedy for the Colicke laid to the
reines of the back it stopps the bloudy fluxe
Openings of the reines heat of the Kidneys weaknesse
of the back, it heales all swellings, Aches & Bruises, &
Ranckes ffellons, Impostumes, pusles & Byles giuen in
[barings?] applied to the fundament it heales all diseases
thereon laid to the head, it is good for the [menitis?]
A Red Cordiall for a Woman in Childbed
XXVIII
Take a quarter of a pint of Cowslip water & as much
Syrupp of Clouegillyflowers & a pennyworth of Cinnamon
water & a Spoonefull of Claret wine & Mace and
Drams mingle all these together and it is a soueraign
cordiall for any especially for one that lyes
in Childbed
Pills for the Gall
XXIX
ffor a weake stomacke griefes and paines
after a Vomit
Take one handfull of Sallandine & as much bay
salt as can take vp betweene yr finger & Thumbe &
the iuice of halfe a Lemon stamp yr together in a
Mortar & straines the iuice out & small this place to
it put some of the hearbs vpon it, vse this goe a 4
leaues together dressing it 3 or 4 times in a Day
together &c
